about_the_game:
What FUNS IS and IS NOT:

Curious if Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate (FUNS) is for you? Here’s a quick guide on what FUNS IS and IS NOT:

Neo Elysia is in chaos. Corruption and crime run rampant. Its citizens suffer, struggling every day to make ends meet with less and less.

They need a hero… and they have one.

Luna Virelith, Agent of AEGIS, has dedicated her life to putting a stop to Nox and the rest of the crime syndicates. She’ll defeat and capture every last one of those scumbags if it's the last thing she does.

So, when a tragic turn of events reveals a once in a lifetime opportunity to go undercover and take the Nox Syndicate down from the inside, she doesn’t back down. Together with the love of her life, Aiden, they venture into the darkness.

But when she emerges from that darkness, will she be the same person?

Multiple Perspectives

Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate is a visual novel, presenting you with two tantalizing methods of experiencing the story:

1) Experiencing it exclusively from the perspective of Aiden as he attempts to take down the infamous Nox Syndicate from the inside, allowing you to only catch glimpses of a much more sordid story that is happening at the same time.

Or

2) Experiencing the story from the perspective of both Aiden and Luna as they both struggle to complete their mission, allowing you to witness Luna’s temptation and corruption in complete detail.

Both methods of playing the game allow for a complete, robust netorare experience in their own rite. The choice is purely up to your preference! 

Status Screen

As you progress through the game, keep track of changes in Luna’s sex life and relationships through the use of the status screen!

The status screen provides you with a specific breakdown on all the juicy details on every sex act that Luna gets up to throughout the game. For your convenience and thrill, it also provides you with notifications when those stats change.

Does all this sound like too much information for you? Want to keep the mystery? That’s fine too! You are also able to limit the amount of information given to you or hide it altogether! Whatever you want to help tailor your mystery NTR experience to your desires!

Codex

The world of Falling Undercover is a world of crime, intrigue and mystery. So, for the inquisitive and lore-curious among you, we’ve included a Codex. Updated as the game progresses and new names and terms are encountered, the Codex can be your guide to New Elysia, its citizens, locations and institutions!

Scene Gallery

Want to peruse some of the hot moments you’ve already encountered and perhaps give some of them another gander? We’ve got you covered. In the Scene Gallery, you can replay some of your favorite FUNS moments again and again.

Don’t have the patience to unlock those scenes in the first place? Well, that’s on you, but we’ve already planned with you in mind. The ability to unlock all scenes in the gallery at the click of a button is available to you right from the start of the game. The choice is yours!

Episode Select

Had a save file a while back, but it got lost somehow? What a pain. Thankfully FUNS has an Episode Select feature that allows you to skip to the episode you wish quickly and painlessly. Just answer a few quick questions and you’ll be back in the story, right where you left off. Easy as pie.  

Development and Future of FUNS

Since you have read this far: Thank you so much for your time and interest in FUNS! If you would like to follow the game's development, we will be posting monthly updates in the Steam community forum, documenting our progress on the game.

We also offer ways to play the game's current build before the official Steam release, allowing you to get a taste of FUNS whenever you desire. You can find out about how to get access by visiting our website (you can find the link to our website in the aforementioned Steam community forum, or alternatively on the right side of this page, scrolling up a bit).

We plan to release the game's final version for purchase on Steam some time in 2026, and are working on a demo version playable for free ahead of time. We don't have a release date for the demo yet, but you can rest assured that it won't be too far in the future.

Be it for an early build or the final version, we wish you much fun in the world of FUNS!

content_descriptors.notes:
Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate contains a wide variety of sexual content, including:

-Nudity
-Oral, Vaginal and Anal sex
-Cheating (Netorare)
-Corruption
-Bodysuits

It also contains descriptions of violence, alcohol use and criminal activity.

All characters in the game are 18+ and all sexual acts in the game are consensual. Must be 18 years or older to play.
